scenarios.name: Activate another expanded command while a command context menu is open

scenario_steps.name: the full 3D Model ribbon is visible
the part has no visible unadaptive sketch suitable for Bend Part
the Modify additional command area is open and unpinned
the user right-clicks Move Bodies in the additional area
the command context menu is visible
the user clicks Bend Part outside that menu
the context menu closes and a notice says a visible unadaptive sketch is needed
the Modify additional command area remains visible behind the notice
the notice closes and the Modify additional command area closes
no bend feature has been created
